messages:
Lina (Paloma): Hey team — we'd like to onboard a custom reranker for our patient support search. Main asks: handle PHI carefully, surface earliest-relevant docs, and slash false positives for sensitive content. Who can own?
Ravi (CSM): Adding folks. Renewal for Paloma is in 8 weeks so this is high priority. Do you need Dedicated or Private?
Lina (Paloma): Dedicated pool in our VPC preferred. Also must integrate with our HSM for key rotation every 90 days.
Diego (SolutionsEng): Noted. Reranker — expected qps and model size? Any candidate model or do you need us to pick?
Lina (Paloma): Target 70 qps, model ~7B fine-tuned, full-text rerank, scoring latency p95 <=120ms. We'll share training checkpoint and sample queries.
Mei (Safety): PHI handling means redaction + strict retention. We need a labeled sensitive-span set and a golden relevance set for QA. Can you share a 500-query golden set and 300 labeled spans?
Lina (Paloma): We can produce those within 10 business days. Also: embargoed data cannot leave their VPC.
Diego (SolutionsEng): For Dedicated within VPC, we can deploy model behind routing policy. Est infra: 2xA100 small GPU nodes for throughput/replication. Will confirm after perf run.
Diego (SolutionsEng): Example runtime config (draft): ```service: paloma-rerank-v1
model: paloma/7b-rerank-finetuned
replicas: 2
gpu: a100-40gb
batching: dynamic
latency_target_p95_ms: 120
routing: dedicated-vpc-us-east-1
hsm_integration: true
```
Mei (Safety): Eval plan: 1) PHI redaction recall/precision on 300 spans 2) relevance A/B vs baseline on 500 queries (NDCG, MRR) 3) adversarial prompts to check leakage. Propose pass gates: redaction recall >=0.98, leakage=0.
Priya (Renewals): FYI — if this ships before renewal it'll be a net retention positive. If we miss the timeline >4 weeks they escalate. Let's lock a launch window.
Ravi (CSM): Proposed timeline: a) data/artifact share by Lina in 10 days, b) perf + safety evals run in 7 days after that, c) enablement + handoff within 3 business days post-evals. Total ~3.5 weeks. Lina, OK?
Lina (Paloma): Sounds tight but feasible. We'll prioritize the artifact share.
onboard-bot: Onboarding ticket created: https://redwood.internal/onboard/4532109876 assigned to Diego, Mei, Ravi
Diego (SolutionsEng): I'll schedule perf runs as soon as we have the model tar + tokenizer. ETA on perf report: 72 hours after receipt.
Mei (Safety): I'll draft the eval matrix and checklist by Thursday. Will include audit log requirements for HSM and retention enforcement (embeddings retention=0 days unless allowed).
Ravi (CSM): I'll prepare the customer-facing plan and include milestone risk flags for Renewals. Tagging @Priya for renewal playbook entries.
Priya (Renewals): Added a renewal note: feature as a QBR talking point, potential for a small discount if they sign multi-year. Also capturing risk: 1) deployment delay 2) safety fail -> rollback.
Diego (SolutionsEng): Quick technical note: if we see tokenization mismatch with their finetune, request the original tokenizer; otherwise scoring drift.
Lina (Paloma): We'll include tokenizer and a small validation corpus. Also need a runbook for on-call and rollback.
Diego (SolutionsEng): We'll produce a runbook and a canary plan.
Mei (Safety): Requesting their SOC contact and retention policy doc. Lina pls drop links.
Lina (Paloma): Dropping assets to their secure share tomorrow: link coming.
Ravi (CSM): Action items recap: Diego — perf + infra estimate (72h after model). Mei — eval matrix by Thu. Lina — share artifacts in 10 days. Ravi — customer doc + enablement call (tentative Tue 11am ET). Priya — renewal note added.
Lina (Paloma): Thanks all :pray:
onboard-bot: Reminder: please post eval artifacts to the onboarding ticket and tag @Mei within 24h of completion.
